doc.title: Sheryl Bailey interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, July 24, 2023

title: Anat Cohen tentet and scheduling touring bands
summary: Bailey hopes for new tentet music and notes bookings are made far ahead, with occasional subs.

blocks.x: music for the tentet. That is a really fun, super fun project. So anyway that’ll, there’ll be more chapters of that band too.

Is it hard to get particular individuals together for a tour like that? Everybody’s got to sort of clear their calendar and say you have to tell your Berklee folks well I’m going to be engaged elsewhere —
Yeah, well they usually book these things pretty far in advance. Every once in a while we’ll have to have a sub — we always say somebody’s great, but yeah, it can be difficult.
